name: Portland
tagline: Coffee, bookstores, gardens, and food carts.
description: A laid-back city split by the Willamette River, known for independent coffee, a big walkable bookstore, gardens, and food-cart pods. Neighborhoods on both sides of the river suit an unhurried weekend.

fromSanFrancisco.typicalTravel: About a 1 h 45 min flight, or a full-day drive

gettingAround.summary: MAX light rail runs from the airport to downtown; the streetcar and buses cover central neighborhoods.

highlights.title: Powell's City of Books
highlights.note: A block-sized bookstore in the Pearl District.

highlights.title: Food-cart pods
highlights.note: Clusters of food carts with varied, casual options.

highlights.title: Washington Park and Forest Park
highlights.note: The Japanese Garden, the International Rose Test Garden, and miles of forest trails.

highlights.title: Portland Art Museum and Alberta Arts District
highlights.note: A downtown museum plus a gallery-and-mural neighborhood.

highlights.title: Neighborhood music venues
highlights.note: Small and mid-size venues across the city.

weatherNotes: Mild, dry summers; frequent drizzle from roughly October to May, so indoor backups matter.

demoDailyBudgetPerPersonUsd.note: Fabricated demo range, not a current price.

travelTips: Plan an indoor block for rainy months.
Oregon has no sales tax, but restaurant and lodging taxes still apply.
